failures.plugin_rejected: The Owner rejected the plugin call. No approved execution was dispatched for that call.
failures.plugin_approval_expired: The plugin call approval expired before execution. Submit a new task if it is still needed.
failures.plugin_changed: Plugin tools or Bot grants changed. Review the installed plugin and submit a new task.
failures.plugin_unavailable: The plugin call could not be confirmed. Check the plugin service; OpenBot did not automatically retry it.
failures.attachment_model_unsupported: Image/PDF input is not enabled for this provider or model. Choose a compatible OpenAI or Anthropic model, or attach a text version.
failures.attachment_unavailable: A task attachment is missing, outside this channel, damaged or exceeds its limits. Attach the file again before submitting a new task.
failures.model_credentials: Model credentials were rejected. Verify the provider key in Settings before submitting a new task.
failures.model_rate_limit: The model provider rate limit was reached. Wait before submitting a new task.
failures.model_unavailable: The model provider is unavailable. Check the configured model and service status.
failures.settings_changed: Model settings changed during this task. Review the current configuration and submit a new task.
failures.scope_revoked: This Bot no longer has access to the task channel. Check its membership.
failures.invalid_target: This task referenced an unknown or ineligible target. Review its task details and available collaborators or resources.
failures.conflict: The task state changed before this update could be saved. Check the latest Run status before submitting a new task.
failures.skills_changed: Reviewed skills changed during this task. Review the current skill assignments and submit a new task.
failures.memory_changed: Employee memory changed during this task. Review current memory and submit a new task.
failures.task_limit: The task exceeded its execution limits. Split it into smaller tasks.
failures.tool_unavailable: A scoped tool could not complete. Check the task URLs and requested capability.
failures.task_timeout: The task reached its time limit. Try a smaller task or check the provider connection.
failures.server_interrupted: The Server interrupted this task. Submit a new task when it is ready.
failures.execution_failed: The Agent could not complete. Check model settings, channel access and task scope before submitting a new task.
